"""Offline verification only. Sandbox keeps repository read-only and supplies pinned source authority."""
from pathlib import Path
import builtins
import contextlib
import io
import json
import tempfile
import types
from core import company_filters
root=Path(company_filters.__file__).resolve().parent.parent
src_path=root/"tools/ats_review_interactive.py"
cli_path=root/"jobctl.py"
original=src_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
original_cli=cli_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
signature="*,input_fn:Callable[[str],str]=input,print_fn:Callable[[str],None]=print)->dict[str,Any]:"
assert original.count(signature)==1 and original.count("    decisions=[]")==1,"SOURCE_SHAPE_CHANGED"
patched=original.replace(signature,"*,input_fn:Callable[[str],str]|None=None,print_fn:Callable[[str],None]=print)->dict[str,Any]:").replace("    decisions=[]","    if input_fn is None:\n        input_fn = input\n    decisions=[]")
compile(patched,str(src_path),"exec")
parser_anchor='    review_parser = subparsers.add_parser("ats-review-queue"'
dispatch_anchor='        if args.command == "ats-review-queue":'
assert original_cli.count(parser_anchor)==1 and original_cli.count(dispatch_anchor)==1 and "ats-review-interactive" not in original_cli,"CLI_CHANGED"
assert original_cli.count("import json\n")>=1,"IMPORT_SHAPE_CHANGED"
cli=original_cli.replace("import json\n","import json\nimport sys\n",1)
cli=cli.replace(parser_anchor,'''    interactive_review = subparsers.add_parser("ats-review-interactive", help="Human-confirmed ATS answer review; no submission")
    interactive_review.add_argument("--fields", required=True)
    interactive_review.add_argument("--bank", required=True)
    interactive_review.add_argument("--employer", required=True)
    interactive_review.add_argument("--verified-profile-keys", default="")

'''+parser_anchor)
cli=cli.replace(dispatch_anchor,'''        if args.command == "ats-review-interactive":
            from tools.ats_review_answer_matches import build_review_with_verified_matches
            from tools.ats_review_interactive import review_interactively
            from tools.ats_verified_answer_bank import load_bank
            fields=json.loads(Path(args.fields).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if not isinstance(fields,list) or any(not isinstance(item,dict) for item in fields):
                raise ValueError("fields must be an array of metadata objects")
            keys={key.strip() for key in args.verified_profile_keys.split(",") if key.strip()}
            batch=build_review_with_verified_matches(fields,keys,load_bank(Path(args.bank)),args.employer)
            summary=review_interactively(Path(args.bank),batch["human_review"],args.employer,print_fn=lambda line:print(line,file=sys.stderr))
            _json_print(summary)
            return 0
'''+dispatch_anchor)
compile(cli,str(cli_path),"exec")
assert "print(line,file=sys.stderr)" in cli and "\nimport sys\n" in cli
from tools.ats_verified_answer_bank import load_bank
mod=types.ModuleType("ats_review_interactive_offline_candidate")
exec(compile(patched,str(src_path),"exec"),mod.__dict__)
items=[{"id":"q1","question":"Do you use AI?","status":"human_review","required":True}]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="jobpipe-review-smoke-") as folder:
    bank=Path(folder)/"answers.json"
    answers=iter(["PRIVATE_SYNTHETIC_VALUE","employer","VERIFY","SAVE"])
    old_input=builtins.input
    prompts=io.StringIO()
    try:
        builtins.input=lambda prompt:next(answers)
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as stdout:
            summary=mod.review_interactively(bank,items,"Example",print_fn=lambda line:print(line,file=prompts))
    finally:
        builtins.input=old_input
    assert summary["saved_count"]==1 and summary["submission"]=="not_attempted"
    assert load_bank(bank)[0]["answer"]=="PRIVATE_SYNTHETIC_VALUE"
    assert bank.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600
    assert "PRIVATE_SYNTHETIC_VALUE" not in json.dumps(summary)+stdout.getvalue()+prompts.getvalue()
    cancelled=Path(folder)/"cancelled.json"
    responses=iter(["TEST_CANCEL","global","VERIFY","CANCEL"])
    old_input=builtins.input
    try:
        builtins.input=lambda prompt:next(responses)
        summary2=mod.review_interactively(cancelled,items,"Example",print_fn=lambda line:None)
    finally:
        builtins.input=old_input
    assert summary2["saved_count"]==0 and not cancelled.exists()
assert src_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")==original and cli_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")==original_cli
print("V1_OFFLINE_INTERACTIVE_REVIEW_REPAIR_SMOKE_PASS",json.dumps({"source_pinned":True,"candidate_cli_compiles":True,"runtime_input_fix":True,"answer_verified":True,"cancel_no_save":True,"bank_private_0600":True,"no_answer_leak":True,"repo_unchanged":True,"application_submissions":0},sort_keys=True))
